name: GitHub Comments
description: Adds a comment section to your Bludit site powered by GitHub issues through Utterances, so visitors comment with their GitHub account and the discussion lives in your own repository.

features.0: Comments backed by GitHub issues in a repository you choose
features.1: Independent toggles for pages, static pages and sticky pages
features.2: Follow Site Theme option syncs the widget with light/dark mode
features.3: Six manual theme overrides including github-light and github-dark
features.4: Renders nothing until a repository is configured
